items.title: Carolyn Buck Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: I know Bill Russell, he came up and he tried to get me to sleep on a wheelchair a couple nights.

ctx.x: At what point do you think that he knew that he was going to die?

He died January 31st. I would say... December 31st. December. I don't know why I always say January. December 31st. I'm sorry. December 31st. About two days after Christmas. And that's when we started praying heavily, both together. That's when I would try to fall asleep, and he was worried. My feet were swelling. He was so worried. He says, Carolyn, I'm going. He says, please keep your strength. You'll need it. And he tried to reassure me. I know Bill Russell, he came up and he tried to get me to sleep on a…
You were there the night that he played his last job. Did he send at that time? I mean, did he maybe sense that that was the last time he was going to play anything? Or not?
